plugin.name: FBA Compatibility
plugin.description:
For OpenMW Full Body Awareness (https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/56625), which shows your whole body in first person: ReAnimation's first-person animations with FBA's legs, hips and movement, so your body walks, runs and lunges with them instead of standing in the first-person pose.
Requires OpenMW Full Body Awareness. Leave this unticked if you don't use it.

plugin.name: Improved Thrown Weapon Projectiles - OpenMW fix
plugin.description:
For R-Zero's Improved Thrown Weapon Projectiles (https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/44763), which makes thrown weapons fly point first and the knives and stars spin. In OpenMW its knives and stars turn 90 degrees in your hand while you throw or draw them; this fixes that, flies the stars flat instead of on edge, and spins everything faster.
Improved Thrown Weapon Projectiles has to be installed (its main files - the darts come from there), before this mod. Its Patches folder and its Glass Glowset patch are not needed: the next page has fixed versions of all of them.
Leave this unticked if you don't use Improved Thrown Weapon Projectiles.

plugin.name: Iron Mesh Improvements
plugin.description:
For Psymoniser's Iron Mesh Improvements (https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/34844): the iron throwing knife to match its iron weapons.
Replaces Improved Thrown Weapon Projectiles' own patch for it, which you don't need to install.

plugin.name: Improved Weapon Meshes - Steel
plugin.description:
For Pherim's Improved Weapon Meshes - Steel (https://www.nexusmods.com/morrowind/mods/43120): the steel throwing knife, star and dart to match its steel weapons.
Replaces Improved Thrown Weapon Projectiles' own patches for it, which you don't need to install. The steel throwing knife only uses this mesh with a plugin that fixes the vanilla record, such as Improved Weapon Meshes - Steel's "Steel Throwing Knife_fix.esp".
